name: IP ICR-MRP Filler Integration
brief: Assembly Order / Purchase Order subcontracting orchestration and inventory distribution for integrated fillers (ICR).
description: Implements the Functional Design Document for ICR-MRP integration v3: Create PO Link, outbound production request and BOM transmission, inbound completion processing, partial completion, over-receipt, pricing validation, scrap posting, phantom lot (ADO 1507) assignment and the Filler Integration Activity Log. Also implements the Functional Design Document for ICR - Inventory Orchestration: PO release and TO shipment trigger points, inbound ICR movements (030 goods receipt of POs / TOs, 311 finished goods transfer to the 3PL with phantom lot XXXX) and Difarco hand-off.
